title: Minimal daily habit tracker
problem: People who want to build small daily habits abandon complex trackers; they need a low-friction way to check off habits and see streaks.
audience: Working adults trying to sustain 1-5 personal habits, mobile-first.
coreTasks: Add a habit with a schedule
Check off today's habits in under ten seconds
Get a reminder at a chosen time

features.name: One-tap check-in
features.description: Mark a habit done from the main screen with one tap.

features.name: Streaks and stats
features.description: Streak counter and weekly/monthly consistency view.

features.name: Pause or archive habits
features.description: Temporarily pause a habit without losing history.

constraints: Different-domain fixture used to prevent wedding-invitation overfitting in tests
